svg.title: Raasta FM Driver Mode — a rear-following journey down an Indian village road at dusk, behind a music bus
svg.desc: Hand-authored original illustration (vector primitives only, no traced or embedded reference imagery). Inspired only by the general mood of a warm, cinematic evening road journey — not copied from any other product's artwork, layout, or source. A wide music bus, seen from behind, travels a perspective road through a lived-in village of chai stalls, houses, shops, trees and electric poles under a warm sunset sky.
